7.t: (4) EXPLANATION OF THE ITEMS The following screen below will appear. Select item to be modified with Player 1 JOYSTICK up/down and move JOYSTICK right/left to modify setting. 3. COLOR CHECK Adjust color brightness so that the specified area will be colorless.
4. MASK ROM CHECK Roms will be checked one after another, and the message ‘‘OK”’ or “‘BAD”’ will be displayed on the screen.
